title: Matrix groups and symmetry
summary: The general and special linear groups over a field; the Euclidean inner product and the orthogonal group O(n), with the equivalent characterisations of orthogonal matrices; isometries of the plane; finite symmetry groups and the wallpaper groups.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is chapter 12 of Judson (Sections 12.1–12.2).

preparation.description: Read Section 12.1: facts from linear algebra, GL_n and SL_n, the orthogonal group (Proposition 12.1.6, Theorem 12.1.8).
Read Section 12.2 (symmetry and the wallpaper groups) from the chapter page.
